name: What we need from new clients
summary: The short list for a first meeting: last year's return, this year's forms, and a list of questions.
body:
Bring or send last year's federal and state returns, any notices you have received, and this year's forms as they arrive. Write down your questions: the first meeting is free and lasts about thirty minutes.

  • Last two years of returns
  • Any IRS or state letters
  • Photo ID for each adult on the return
  • Business owners: last year-end balance sheet

name: How to read your engagement letter
summary: What each section of the letter means, including the fee and what is out of scope.
body:
The engagement letter says what we will do, what you will provide, the fee and what is not included. If something you expected is not in the scope section, ask before you sign.

  • Scope: the returns and services covered
  • Your responsibilities: documents and dates
  • Fee: fixed, with what changes it
  • Out of scope: notices, amended returns, cleanup

name: 2026 tax organizer: how to fill it in
summary: Go section by section, skip what does not apply, and mark anything new this year.
body:
The organizer in your portal is pre-filled from last year. Confirm each section, mark sections that no longer apply, and add anything new: a new job, a sale, a birth, a move. Upload documents against each line; the line turns green when it is matched.

Client code for this demo: TP-ORG-2026 (fictional).

name: Document checklist: individuals and families
summary: Every form we usually need for a family return, with where each one comes from.
body:
• W-2s from each employer (January)
  • 1099-INT, DIV and B from banks and brokers (February)
  • 1098 mortgage interest statement (January)
  • Property tax bills paid
  • Childcare provider name, address and amount
  • Charitable receipts over $250
  • Estimated payment confirmations

name: Document checklist: business owners
summary: The year-end package for a business return.
body:
• December bank, card and loan statements
  • Year-end payroll reports and W-3
  • Fixed asset purchases and sales with invoices
  • Owner distributions and contributions
  • 1099s issued to contractors
  • Inventory count at December 31

name: Sending documents securely
summary: Use the portal upload, never email attachments. Paper can be dropped at the front desk.
body:
Upload from the Documents tab in the client portal (fictional Ledgerbox app). Files are matched to your organizer lines. Please do not email returns or statements. Drop-off box at 14 Wharf Street is checked twice a day.

Portal help line: (555) 017-4410, extension 240.

name: E-signing your return
summary: When the return is ready you get a signing request; the return is filed after both forms are signed.
body: We send a signing request for the e-file authorization (Form 8879) and the engagement letter. Each adult on a joint return signs separately. We file within one business day of the last signature and send the acceptance confirmation.

name: Busy-season review checklist
summary: The second-preparer review every return gets before it goes to a partner.
body:
• Prior-year comparison: any line that moved more than 20% has a note
  • Every 1099 and K-1 in the organizer is on the return
  • Estimates paid match the confirmations
  • State apportionment checked for multi-state clients
  • Letter to client drafted

name: Extension cutoff procedure
summary: Which returns get extended on April 1, and how the balance is estimated.
body: On April 1 every individual return without a complete organizer is extended. The preparer estimates the balance from the organizer and last year, Marisol reviews anything over $5,000, and the client gets a payment voucher by April 8.

name: Notice intake procedure
summary: Log the notice the day it arrives, scan all pages, and assign it within one business day.
body: Log in the notice tracker with the client code, the agency, the notice number and the response date. Scan all pages, including the blank ones. Marisol assigns it within one business day; replies go out within ten.

name: Engagement letter template (individuals)
summary: The current template for individual returns, with the fee table.
body: Use the template in the practice system. Fees: one state $650; each additional state $150; rental schedule $175 each; business schedule from $300. Partners approve anything outside the table.
